mechanism: Keep E057 selected F-free fragments, but connect successive source positions within each original page. Exact chain DP maximizes fragment language scores subject to phase_b-phase_a=(b-a)-s mod m, 0<=s<=ciphertext F count in [a,b). Empty original pages retained by full optimizer. No connection between different pages.
initialization: 64 starts for N<=1024,16 otherwise; top4/top2 cyclic distinct unigram fits. Seed3303058+1000*sign_index+period. First three starts set each page's first fragment phase0 and interval skips0/all/half; subsequent starts sample page first phases uniformly and interval skip counts uniformly0..Fcount. Iterate exact constrained phases/unigram key up to20 times; same3bigram/3fourgram refinement,20 diversified full-text candidates and coupled-context key/F/phase refinement as E057. Periods17..32,both signs. Existing conservative fragment-phase penalty unchanged.

bounds: 512..4096runes,<=16pages,<=12fragments cap256,<=32keyslots; chain DP <=32states and<=1024edges perlink. Fullcontext <=16384states. Oneprocess,BLAS1,768MiB sampled private/resident watchdog,180seconds perexperiment,phase21 total2400seconds. No unknown scan in this calibration experiment.
